name: Stumps
summary: Pixel-art cricket stumps with two bails, game-inventory style; for cricket, sports and backyard game scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the item (centre when centre = true)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; one cell = 24 px at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: whole-sprite motion; shake suits a hit wicket

params.name: centre
params.note: anchor on the centre instead of the bottom

params.name: colour
params.note: main wood colour (char a), e.g. #8a5a2b for darker wood
